# Policy: deny model-training crawlers; permit search indexing, AI search,
# user-driven fetches/search. Permitted bots inherit "*". Assigning a bot
# its own group would loosen its access unless the rules for "*" are repeated.
# This file is advisory; enforce at the CDN/WAF if a denial must actually hold.

# Advise bots on what to crawl.
Sitemap: https://pbskids.org/sitemap.xml

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# General bot/crawler rules. Applies to all bots not explicitly denied access below.
# For an idea on which AIs have access, here is a list of known bots as of 9/11/26:
#
#   AI search indexers:
#     OAI-SearchBot         ChatGPT search index
#     Claude-SearchBot      Claude search index
#     PerplexityBot         Perplexity index
#     Applebot              Siri and Spotlight
#
#   User-initiated live fetchers (a person asked; the assistant retrieves):
#     ChatGPT-User
#     Claude-User
#     Perplexity-User
#     Meta-ExternalFetcher
#
#   Bots that serve responses and search indexing:
#     Amazonbot
#
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
User-agent: *
Disallow: /_next/
Disallow: /puma/
Disallow: /test-data/

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DENY training crawlers and opt-out tokens. Google-Extended and Applebot-Extended
# only affect Gemini / Apple Intelligence training, not Search, Siri, or Spotlight.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: anthropic-ai
User-agent: CCBot
User-agent: meta-externalagent
User-agent: Bytespider
User-agent: cohere-ai
User-agent: Diffbot
User-agent: Omgilibot
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Disallow: /
